info.title: ExpenseFlow API
info.summary: Expense claims, policy checks, approvals, audit and payout.
info.description:
The single API contract for the frontend. The committed copy is `docs/openapi.json`.

**Auth:** `POST /api/v1/auth/login` returns `access_token`; send it on every other call as
`Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Dev login: `admin` / `admin` (finance_head).

**Roles:** `finance_head`, `employee`, `line_manager`, `finance_auditor`.

**Errors** always have the shape `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": {}}}`.
Branch on `error.code`, show `error.message`.

get.summary: Liveness - is the API process up (public, ops only)
get.description: Return 200 whenever the process is running. Never touches the database.

get.summary: Readiness - 200 if the database answers, 503 if not (public, ops only)
get.description:
Return 200 when the database answers, 503 when it does not.

Returning 503 rather than raising keeps the body shape stable, so a
dashboard or an alert rule can parse the same JSON either way.

post.summary: Log in with username or work email + password; returns a bearer token (public)
post.description:
The `username` field accepts either the username or the work email (case-insensitive).
Send the returned `access_token` as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every other
call. Unknown user, wrong password and inactive user all return the same 401.

get.summary: Finance overview for one month: KPIs, my actions, spend charts, recent events (finance_auditor and finance_head only)
get.description:
Spend, claim counts and violations cover counted claims (not draft, rejected,
auto-rejected or duplicate) submitted in the month. Each KPI carries the previous
month for the "vs last month" figure. `ready_for_payout` uses the payout batch rules
(approved, not yet in a batch or paid). `spend_by_department` groups by the claimant's
department.

assigned_approver_id.title: Assigned Approver Id
assigned_approver_id.description: Named approver; null means any active user with approver_role.

average_hours.title: Average Hours
average_hours.description: Submit -> final approval (approved_at), averaged over claims approved by people this month, including those since paid; auto-approved claims excluded. Null when there were none.

step_id.title: Step Id
step_id.description: The step being decided. If it is no longer the current step, 409. Send it so a double click or retry can never decide a later step.

BatchCreate.title: BatchCreate
BatchCreate.description:
Either ``{"range": "TODAY"}`` or ``{"fromDate": ..., "toDate": ...}`` (IST days,
inclusive, on the claim's approval date).

receipt_id.title: Receipt Id
receipt_id.description: Id of a receipt already uploaded to this claim.

ClaimLineIn.title: ClaimLineIn
ClaimLineIn.description:
One line as sent by the client. Every field is optional so drafts can be partial;
submission enforces the required ones.

ClaimStatus.title: ClaimStatus
ClaimStatus.description:
Claim lifecycle.

DRAFT -> SUBMITTED -> AUTO_APPROVED | AUTO_REJECTED | PENDING_APPROVAL
PENDING_APPROVAL -> APPROVED | REJECTED | CLARIFICATION_REQUESTED
CLARIFICATION_REQUESTED -> (edit, resubmit) -> SUBMITTED
SUBMITTED -> DUPLICATE when a line repeats an earlier line's vendor, amount and
receipt number; final, no approval chain, not editable.
APPROVED | AUTO_APPROVED -> PAID (in a payout batch)
SUBMITTED is transient: the policy engine runs in the same transaction.

ClaimWrite.title: ClaimWrite
ClaimWrite.description: Body for create and update. ``action`` decides draft vs submit.

month.title: Month
month.description: The month summarised, YYYY-MM (business time zone).

monthly_spend.description: January to December of the month's year.

spend_by_department.title: Spend By Department
spend_by_department.description: This month by the claimant's department, largest first; users without a department are grouped as 'Unassigned'.

step_id.title: Step Id
step_id.description: The step being decided. If it is no longer the current step, 409. Send it so a double click or retry can never decide a later step.

DecisionRequest.title: DecisionRequest
DecisionRequest.description: Reject and send back: a comment is mandatory.

action.title: Action
action.description: Audit action: APPROVED, REJECTED, SENT_BACK, STEP_APPROVED, POLICY_RULE_UPDATED, BATCH_CREATED or BATCH_EXPORTED.

my_pending_approvals.title: My Pending Approvals
my_pending_approvals.description: Approval steps waiting on the caller (same rule as GET /approvals/pending).

high_value_pending.description: Claims awaiting approval with a total above the finance_head threshold.

claims.title: Claims
claims.description: Claims a payout batch could pay now: approved or auto-approved, fully approved, not in a batch, not paid, not held for sample audit (any approval date).

on_behalf_of_id.title: On Behalf Of Id
on_behalf_of_id.description: Set when this item reaches you through a delegation.

line_position.title: Line Position
line_position.description: 1-based line position; null for a finding about the whole claim.

PolicyRuleUpdate.title: PolicyRuleUpdate
PolicyRuleUpdate.description: Send only what changes. ``params`` replaces the whole params object.

lines.title: Lines

total_lines.title: Total Lines
total_lines.description: All lines of this month's counted claims.

rate_percent.title: Rate Percent
rate_percent.description: lines / total_lines x 100, one decimal; 0 if none.
